alt: 指揮官在地圖上推進多支軍隊，無視空糧籃與疲憊的運輸者；窗外軍車成列、田地荒廢。
scene_prompt: 窮兵黷武 means recklessly squandering national resources on repeated aggressive wars, not a defensive force or celebrating military strength. Contemporary fictional military command room. An arrogant generic commander wearing a plain unmarked uniform stands at a large table greedily pushing several tank-shaped wooden tokens toward multiple neighboring territories on an entirely unlabeled blank-bordered map, ignoring a worried civilian adviser who holds out an almost empty food basket. Through a wide background window, long rows of generic military vehicles and exhausted marching troops dominate the distant land while nearby civilian grain fields are neglected and a plain school building has broken windows. Three main humans only: commander, worried adviser, weary soldier delivering another box of military supplies. Tanks are distant simplified silhouettes with coherent tracks; no insignia, flags, logos, current world leaders, real borders or readable markings. Clear critical educational narrative of overusing force while civilian needs are neglected. No blood, firing weapons, explosions, injuries or dangerous action.
